claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CNQX is a quinoxalinedione AMPA/kainate glutamate receptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly reflecting quinoxalinedione off-target activity rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
